adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent` now computes `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. The `.find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so it compares `cal.externalId === undefined` and will almost always return `undefined`, effectively removing the previous fallback to the event’s destination calendar. The same flawed pattern is used in `deleteEvent` (and also uses a `defaultCalendarId = "primary"`), so when `externalCalendarId` is not provided these operations will target `primary` or potentially pass `undefined`, changing update/cancel behavior compared to the prior `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` fallback.
